title: Multi-angle video from one camera (چندزاویه): face / person detectors, Depth-Anything-V2-Small and a small Python environment (numpy, OpenCV, onnxruntime-directml) - all run on the GPU node, installed automatically
license_note: Every file is permissively licensed and used only on this node, on the owner's own footage: YuNet face detector (OpenCV Zoo / libfacedetection.train, MIT), YOLOS-tiny person detector (hustvl/yolos-tiny, Apache-2.0; ONNX export by Xenova), Depth-Anything-V2-Small (depth-anything, Apache-2.0; ONNX export by onnx-community). NOT used on purpose: Depth-Anything-V2 Base / Large (CC-BY-NC-4.0) and Ultralytics YOLO (AGPL-3.0). Python packages: numpy (BSD-3), opencv-python-headless (Apache-2.0), onnxruntime-directml (MIT). Files come from Hugging Face pinned to the commit the sha256 was taken from (the downloader tries hf-mirror.com when huggingface.co is unreachable; YuNet also from the OpenCV Zoo on GitHub). The site also keeps a copy of the three files in data/up3d/downloads/ (multiangle-*.onnx, same bytes) and that mirror is the first url, so the node does not depend on Hugging Face being reachable. Sizes and sha256 are verified either way. All packages are small (about 0.4 GB together) and NOT optional: the node's start-up download, Update.bat and the agent's own automatic install (multiangle_jobs.py) fetch them without anybody asking.

packages.multiangle-runtime: Python environment for multi-angle video: numpy + OpenCV + onnxruntime-directml (runs the models on any DirectX 12 GPU, the RTX 3060 included, without a CUDA install; CPU when the GPU is busy)
packages.multiangle-detect: YuNet face detector (0.2 MB) + YOLOS-tiny person detector (25 MB): who is in the picture and where
packages.multiangle-depth: Depth-Anything-V2-Small (ONNX, 95 MB): depth for 2.5D camera moves

items.title: Python packages for multi-angle video (numpy, opencv-python-headless, onnxruntime-directml)
items.sources_note: The same sources the photo-matting runtime uses (checked from Iran: aliyun serves the cp310-cp312 win_amd64 wheels). DirectML works on every DX12 GPU without a CUDA install; the engine falls back to the CPU by itself and says so in the result.
